**The native build of 1.3.0-beta.1.** It's the same code as 1.3.0-beta.1, published so panels on the **Native** channel get the 1.3.0 features: stats and leaderboards, Discord commands and chat, the web map and in-panel Help. Native work now lives on `main`, and every system helper job has been ported to Rust, so this is the build to try the Rust agent on. It's still off until you switch it on.

Testing: follow [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/native-1.3.0-beta.1.native.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md) on a spare VPS, and check that switching back to the Bun agent still works.
